name: Teferi's Isle
description: A hidden realm in the Chaza Isles that phased out of existence for two hundred years.

description_citations.text: "Teferi Akosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's phasing energy burst makes every plant, animal and building on his isle phase out of existence.
timeline.quote: The energy unleashed caused every plant, animal, and building on the island to phase out of existence, leaving just bare rock behind.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Ancient History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara, Jolrael and Kaervek meet on the barren rock that was Teferi's Isle and settle in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: The three mages met on the barren rock that had once been Teferi's Isle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's attempt to repair the time stream phases everything but bare rock off Teferi's Isle.
timeline.quote: The Phasing of Teferi's Isle caused everything but the bare rock of the island to instantly phase out of existence.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Two hundred years later the isle returns and Teferi learns his cure indirectly caused a great war.
timeline.quote: After two hundred years, Teferi's Isle returned.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's isle returns and he slays one of Jolrael's dragons.
timeline.quote: Teferi slew the dragon and immediately set out to discover what was happening

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael seeks Teferi's help, but he refuses to intercede and offers dreams and visions instead.
timeline.quote: Instead, he offered to guide the leaders of Jamuraa through dreams and visions.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, where Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
timeline.quote: During the battle, Jolrael turned upon Kaervek, severely injuring the mage in a heated arcane battle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Mangara's Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The island where Teferi's phasing experiments made it vanish for nearly two hundred years.

citation.text: "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
